title: Jesus Sends Out the Twelve
description: Jesus called the twelve to himself and sent them out two by two, giving them authority over unclean spirits. He instructed them not to take anything for the journey except a staff—no bread, no bag, no money in their belts. They were to wear sandals but not an extra shirt. Wherever they entered a house, they were to stay there until they left that place. If any place would not welcome them or listen to them, they were to shake the dust off their feet as a testimony against them. The disciples went out and preached that people should repent. They drove out many demons and anointed many sick people with oil and healed them.[ref:Mark 6:7-13|Mark 6:7-13]
